project.name: OpenSEO
project.summary: Ein SEO-Werkzeug zum Selbsthosten: Es recherchiert Suchbegriffe, verfolgt Rankings, prüft Websites und zeigt, ob KI-Assistenten eine Marke nennen. Die Daten kommen von DataForSEO, und auch KI-Assistenten können es über eine eigene Schnittstelle bedienen. Das Studio nutzt einen Fork (derzeit pausiert). Die Karte zeigt nur die Software selbst, ohne Testdateien, Webseite und Datenbank-Migrationen.

issues.title: Any website can call your server from a visitor’s browser
issues.detail: 2 files tell browsers that any website may call this server. That’s fine for a public API that doesn’t use login cookies (for example one that checks a token in the Authorization header); otherwise, allow only your own app’s address.
issues.fix:
Security review: CORS settings that allow every website:
- src/routes/report-map/$grant/copyright.ts:22: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
- src/server/mcp/transport.ts:34: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *

First tell me in plain words whether this server uses login cookies or sessions, and which websites legitimately call it. Then replace the allow-everything setting with an explicit list of allowed origins read from an environment variable (for example ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://myapp.com,http://localhost:3000). Keep credentials only if the app logs in with cookies, and never combine them with "*" or with echoing back whatever origin asks. Show me the change before making it, and change nothing else.

issues.title: 2 files are very large
issues.detail: These files each have over 1,000 lines. AI assistants read and edit big files less reliably: they lose track of what's where and can break one part while fixing another. Splitting them into smaller files by job makes future changes safer.
issues.fix:
Refactor plan: these files are very large:
- src/server/mcp/tools/dataforseo-research-tools.ts (1,159 lines)
- src/server/mcp/tools/local-seo-tools.ts (1,055 lines)

Start with src/server/mcp/tools/dataforseo-research-tools.ts. Read it and propose how to split it into smaller files, each with one clear job (for example by feature or by type of work), keeping every public function name and behaviour the same. Show me the plan first. After I approve, move code in small steps, update the imports, and run the tests after each step. Don't change behaviour.

issues.title: 2 files in Seiten und Adressen look unused
issues.detail: Nothing in the app imports or calls these files (32 lines). Leftover code confuses AI assistants, which may edit or copy the wrong version. Double-check before deleting: some files are loaded in ways the map can't see.
issues.fix:
Cleanup check: these files look unused (nothing imports or calls them):
- src/routes/_app/p/$projectId/context.tsx
- src/routes/api/ga4/oauth/callback.ts

For each file, search the codebase (including configs, scripts, HTML templates and dynamic imports) to confirm nothing uses it. Then tell me which ones are safe to delete and which are actually used, with one line of evidence each. Don't delete anything until I confirm.
